subject: economics
made: 4 Nov 2026, Claude (planning chat), from 37 Indian-economy reference videos (about 4 h 35 min; 346 teaching segments carded in cards/E01-E37.json) and the Money v2 demo that Navin passed
purpose: The director's dictionary for showing: when a narration line says this kind of thing, the picture does this, on the word it is said. Each pattern names the engine parts (all subjects) and the economy saanche it uses. The references are evidence of what works; BIE draws everything itself, in its own style, and must do better where the references fall back to text.

what_the_references_do.camera: mostly still canvases (50% of segments build on the same canvas); about one clear or cut per segment otherwise; zooms or pans in 7%
what_the_references_do.verdict: The references teach well where a picture acts (risk disc moving, vault receiving a slice, a rope pegging one note to another). They fall back to text boxes for comparisons (9 of 23 comparison segments text-only), definitions and lists of reasons. BIE keeps their good pictures as patterns and replaces their text stretches with the same patterns.

bie_targets: Every mechanism, process and cause-effect line is shown by things acting (picture), not by a sentence box.
Diagrams (tree, table, graph, formula) are used for classification, numbers and formulas, built one piece per spoken phrase.
Text on screen: a term pill, a number, a short label; at most about 25 words on screen at once; no sentence box stays more than 10 s.
No logos, emblems, real persons, real landmarks or live footage: institutionBadge, generic buildings and BIE's own people.
Facts come from the book, never from a reference video (several reference claims were doubtful; see cards' notes).

patterns.when: someone gives, pays, deposits, lends or buys
patterns.show: the thing (note bundle, bond paper, goods) travels from the giver's hand or building to the receiver along an arrow, on the verb; the return (repayment, interest, goods) comes back on a dotted arrow
patterns.our_example: जमाकर्ता ₹100 बैंक को देते हैं: नोटों की गड्डी भीड़ से बैंक तक जाती है; साल के अंत में ब्याज की छोटी गड्डी वापस आती है

patterns.when: a two-way deal: sell now and buy back, a loan against security, borrowing by issuing paper
patterns.show: paper goes one way and cash the other at the same time; a frame closes around both arrows so they read as one deal; a contract paper hooks on with the deal's name (REPO) and its term
patterns.our_example: बैंक दो बॉन्ड RBI को देता है, RBI नकद देता है; दोनों तीरों के चारों ओर फ्रेम बनता है और 'REPO · 7 दिन बाद वापस' का कागज़ जुड़ता है

patterns.when: a part of a sum is kept aside, locked or reserved (CRR, SLR, reserves, capital)
patterns.show: the sum is one stack or bar; a slice splits off on the word, travels into a vault (locked, tag '0% ब्याज') or a safe that earns; the rest goes on to its use; the numbers are written on each slice
patterns.our_example: ₹100 की गड्डी तीन हिस्सों में बँटती है: ₹3 RBI की तिजोरी में (ताला, 0% ब्याज), ₹18 सरकारी बॉन्ड में, ₹79 कर्ज़ लेने वालों तक

patterns.when: risk, burden or responsibility moves from one party to another (insurance, swaps, guarantees)
patterns.show: a RISK disc sits on A; on the word it lifts and slides onto B; A's worry bubble (awake at night) turns calm; the price paid travels back from A to B
patterns.our_example: निवेशक के ऊपर लाल 'जोखिम' गोला; बीमा कंपनी को थोड़ी फ़ीस देते ही गोला कंपनी पर चला जाता है और निवेशक चैन से सोता है

patterns.when: a rate, price or quantity changes
patterns.show: the number is struck out and the new one written beside it with a ▲ or ▼, on the word of the new number; the same picture is reused for each cause so only the cause differs
patterns.our_example: दूध ₹50 → ₹60: पुराना दाम कटता है, नया लिखा जाता है, ऊपर हरा तीर

patterns.when: many buyers or sellers react (demand, rush, panic, flight to safety)
patterns.show: a crowd grows or shrinks with the story; crosses fall under those who cannot pay or are left out; the goods go to the few who can
patterns.our_example: 2 ख़रीदार 12 हो जाते हैं, दाम बढ़ता है, 9 के नीचे क्रॉस और बोतलें सिर्फ़ 3 तक पहुँचती हैं

patterns.when: a share of the population is reached or left out (inclusion, coverage, target groups)
patterns.show: one crowd stands for everyone; the reached part is shaded, the rest dimmed or capped in red; target groups get circles with dotted lines from the institution
patterns.our_example: 140 करोड़ की भीड़ का बायाँ हिस्सा पीला (बैंक तक पहुँच), दायाँ लाल (बाहर); छोटे बैंक लाल हिस्से के छोटे समूहों तक रेखा खींचते हैं

patterns.when: items are classified into groups
patterns.show: first the real items crowd around one person or place, then they snap into labelled groups; only then are the group names written. A tree is used only when the items are abstract
patterns.our_example: एक परिवार की महीने भर की चीज़ें चारों ओर, फिर वे 'खाना', 'कपड़े', 'घर', 'ईंधन' के डिब्बों में चली जाती हैं

patterns.when: levels, tiers or who controls whom (state → district → village, regulators)
patterns.show: nested boxes: one box per higher level holding the lower units as small coloured squares, a 'one per state / one per district' label on each level; regulators stand above the units they cover
patterns.our_example: राज्य का बड़ा डिब्बा, उसमें ज़िलों के डिब्बे, उनमें गाँव की समितियों के छोटे वर्ग; ऊपर नियामक का बैज

patterns.when: a law creates or changes something
patterns.show: the law paper drops at its year; a dotted arc runs to what it creates (a new institution) or to the number it changes, which is struck and rewritten; an AMENDED stamp lands on the old paper
patterns.our_example: 1934 पर 'RBI Act' का कागज़ गिरता है, बिंदुदार चाप 1935 पर RBI के बैज तक जाती है

patterns.when: the history of institutions: founding, merger, renaming, moving, nationalisation
patterns.show: a timeline stays as the anchor; merger = a frame closes around two buildings and they become one bigger one; renaming = the old name is struck, the new name and badge appear; moving = a dotted hop arrow to the new city; state ownership = a coloured zone over the years, everything inside it is state-owned
patterns.our_example: तीन प्रेसीडेंसी बैंक एक फ्रेम में आकर एक बड़ा बैंक बनते हैं (1921); 1955 में पुराना नाम कटता है, नया नाम लिखा जाता है

patterns.when: who decides and who follows; a change of authority
patterns.show: arrows run from the decider to those who follow; when authority changes, the same picture stays and the arrows flip direction; a global rule passes through the national regulator to the bank
patterns.our_example: पहले तीर RBI से बैंकों की ओर (दर RBI तय करता है), फिर वही तस्वीर, तीर बैंकों से बाहर (हर बैंक अपनी दर तय करता है)

patterns.when: a problem and its fix
patterns.show: the goals are set up as chips; when the problem arrives they get red crosses; under the fix the same chips get green ticks; the picture stays the same so only the marks change
patterns.our_example: 'पारदर्शिता' और 'एक जैसा नियम' पर पहले लाल क्रॉस, नई व्यवस्था में उन्हीं पर हरा टिक

patterns.when: something fails or defaults
patterns.show: the return arrow is crossed in red, a FAIL stamp lands on the institution, the event is filed into a list of risks that stays on screen
patterns.our_example: कर्ज़ वापस नहीं आया: वापसी का तीर कटता है, बैंक पर 'FAIL' की मुहर, किनारे की सूची में 'क्रेडिट जोखिम' जुड़ता है

patterns.when: a calculation from many items to one number (an index, an average)
patterns.show: one item is followed through every step: its prices, its relative, its weight, into the formula; then the other items join the same path
patterns.our_example: एक अंडा: 10 बाज़ारों के दाम → उसका सूचकांक → टोकरी में उसका वज़न → सूत्र में

patterns.when: where along a chain something happens or is measured
patterns.show: the chain of places (factory → warehouse → shop → family) with goods moving along it; a coloured band drops at each hand-over and names what is measured there
patterns.our_example: कारख़ाने से थोक, थोक से दुकान, दुकान से परिवार; हर हाथ-बदल पर रंगीन पट्टी: थोक दाम, खुदरा दाम

patterns.when: a total is made of parts
patterns.show: the parts stack up with a plus between them and a bracket to the total; or the container (a vault) is drawn as its parts
patterns.our_example: विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार = विदेशी मुद्रा + सोना + SDR + IMF हिस्सा: चार डिब्बे जुड़कर एक तिजोरी

patterns.when: growth or size over time
patterns.show: a tiny object at the start and a huge one at the end of the same line; or a dot walks along the curve and the value tag changes as it moves
patterns.our_example: 1991 की छोटी थैली, आज की बहुत बड़ी थैली, बीच में बढ़ती रेखा

patterns.when: one value is tied to another (a peg, an index link)
patterns.show: a rope or rod ties one note to another note or to a basket of notes; when the anchor moves, the tied note moves with it
patterns.our_example: रुपये का नोट रस्सी से एक टोकरी (कई देशों के नोट) से बँधा है; टोकरी हिलती है तो रुपया भी

patterns.when: a ratio changes because the base changes (base effect, per person)
patterns.show: equal steps with shrinking percentage labels; or drop lines from the total to the number of people so the per-person share is seen to fall while the total rises
patterns.our_example: आय ₹1,000 से ₹2,000, पर लोग 1 से 4: हर व्यक्ति का हिस्सा आधा हो जाता है

patterns.when: permission, a barrier or a forbidden path
patterns.show: a licence paper is a gate things pass through and come out changed; a forbidden path is a dotted arrow blocked by a red cross; a wall blocks a path and the arrows loop around it through a middleman
patterns.our_example: मोबाइल वॉलेट RBI के लाइसेंस से गुज़रकर 'पेमेंट्स बैंक' बनता है; उधार देने की ओर बिंदुदार तीर पर लाल क्रॉस

patterns.when: two things are compared
patterns.show: the same template side by side, one difference at a time with a label each side (mirror pictures); never a text table read out
patterns.our_example: सहकारी बैंक: वही लोग मालिक और ग्राहक (गोल तीर); व्यापारिक बैंक: कुछ मालिक, बहुत बड़ी भीड़ ग्राहक

patterns.when: a gap between two amounts (deficit, shortfall)
patterns.show: a longer bar beside a shorter bar; the missing piece becomes a block with the gap's name; the block then splits into the ways it is filled
patterns.our_example: ख़र्च की लाल पट्टी आमदनी की हरी पट्टी से लंबी; बचा टुकड़ा 'घाटा' बनता है और चार रास्तों में बँटता है

patterns.when: checking a statement (exam practice, notes)
patterns.show: the statement appears; the concept picture it depends on returns; a tick or cross lands on the statement; every option that contains a false statement is crossed too
patterns.our_example: कथन II ग़लत: उस पर क्रॉस और जिन विकल्पों में II है, उन सब पर भी क्रॉस

patterns.when: recap or moving to the next part
patterns.show: a small road map or topic tree stays at the side; the finished branch gets a tick and the next lights up; the lesson returns to its home picture before a new branch
patterns.our_example: बाईं ओर छोटा नक्शा: 'जमा → CRR → SLR → कर्ज़'; CRR पूरा होते ही उस पर टिक
